claim: But instead of waiting for that approval, tech companies keen to build the infrastructure for A.I. are often building gas generators on site.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-13 - not yet checked by the human annotator] 'That approval' is regulators' approval to connect to the grid (the article's previous sentence). BNEF, 'Gas is letting data centers grow beyond the grid' (29 Jul 2026): 'Faced with years-long grid connection delays', 'developers are turning to on-site gas generation to bring projects online faster'. Bloomberg Law (9 Mar 2026): about 114 GW of on-site gas planned at data centers, almost 90% of projects in the US. 'Often' is a reading of that trend.
